entries.zh: 走到一边去；离开到那边
entries.en: to move aside to this side; to step away

entries.zh: 散开；彼此分散（散散、散散）
entries.en: to scatter, disperse from one another
to be apart from one another; to separate
to pull apart, split up
entries.notes: 汉字为「拆散」而闽南音写为 ᵏᵉ hia quã，官话对音 chē sân 与两栏不完全对齐，[疑]。

entries.en: to take apart and separate off
to part deliberately, on purpose (aposta)
entries.notes: 「拆單」此处取「单拆/单独分开」义，义项依赖西语 aposta（故意）推断。

entries.en: to part, detach from

entries.zh: 修道；脱离世俗而修行（隐修）
entries.en: to withdraw from the world for religious life; religious retirement
to withdraw to one side, step back aside
entries.notes: 闽南音写 té quỳ 与官话对音 hùi piēⁿ 分属两读（退 hùi），词形不完全一致，[疑]。

entries.en: to drag apart, pull away
to depart from reason; unreasonable
to depart from justice/right; unrighteous
separately; apart, aparted

entries.zh: 另居；分居别处（独自居住）
entries.en: to live apart, dwell separately

entries.zh: 走样；偏离正道、失其常态
entries.en: to deviate from proper ways; lose its form
entries.notes: 西语词头原文讹乱（delos buen del modo delos modos），依汉字「走样」释义。

entries.en: to remove, cast out, set apart
to break off friendship, sever ties
to be far, go away, take leave; to distant oneself
to forsake, cast off; dissolve the friendship

entries.zh: 出头占伊；热衷出头、抢先占先（对某事上心争先）
entries.en: to grow passionate over something, thrust oneself in first
entries.notes: 四字口语短语，西语 gst 缩写（gozo/后接 aceptacion）展开不确定，依汉字释义。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕落霜；下霜
entries.en: frost to fall; hoarfrost (Spanish headword blank)
entries.notes: 西语栏为 [空]，仅据汉字「落霜」与音写释义。

entries.en: hail to fall; to pelt with stones, hailstorm
entries.notes: 闽南音写多出 yūd rog gog 等难定字音，依西语 Apedrear/pedrisco 与汉字取「落雹」义。

entries.en: to appeal, lodge a complaint at court
entries.notes: 汉字「訴」与官话对音 zōn（尊/准?）及音写 tōu chùng 不完全对齐，依汉字与西语 Apelar 取义。
